summary: Example win_dsc task using the Archive resource to extract a zip file to a destination folder.
questions: How do I unzip a file on Windows with win_dsc?
Which DSC resource extracts zip archives?

answer_card.title: Extracting a zip file with win_dsc
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml+jinja
- name: Extract a zip file
  win_dsc:
    resource_name: Archive
    Destination: C:\temp\output
    Path: C:\temp\zip.zip
    Ensure: Present
```
